an6.31:1.1: “Monks, six qualities lead to the decline of a monk in training.
an6.31:1.3: Delighting in work, delighting in talking, delighting in sleeping, delighting in entanglement, not guarding the sense faculties, not knowing moderation in food.
an6.31:1.4: These six qualities lead to the decline of a monk in training.
an6.31:2.1: “Monks, six qualities lead to the non-decline of a monk in training.
an6.31:2.3: Not delighting in work, not delighting in talking, not delighting in sleeping, not delighting in entanglement, guarding the sense faculties, and knowing moderation in food.
an6.31:2.4: These six qualities lead to the non-decline of a monk in training.”
